title: Claw Axle

labels.text: J1 rear journal Ø8, in the body's MR128
C1 collar Ø8.6, on the MR128's inner race
A1 seat, hex 10 across flats: the finger's box end and the gear's bore
H1 cross hole Ø3.3 along 120°: the finger's set screw through the seat
H2 cross hole Ø3.3 along 120°: the gear's set screw, spare on the follower pivot
C2 collar Ø8.6, on the cap's MR128
J2 front journal Ø8, in the cap's MR128

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. The same part serves both pivots: on the follower's it stands turned 60° on its hex, which puts its cross holes on the follower finger's screw line. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
